individual-data-points.explanation: Spatial deconvolution heatmap overlay on tissue, a heatmap-type visualization that is exempt from requiring individual data points.
Box plots inherently display the data distribution (and individual points are additionally overlaid), so this is exempt and passes.
GSEA enrichment score line plots are a line-plot type, which is exempt from requiring individual data points.

Bars show a single aggregated log2 fold-change statistic per gene from a DEG/statistical comparison (with associated p-value), not a mean of independent replicate measurements, so individual points are not applicable.
Panel contains H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Spatial heatmap plot uses a color scale, not error bars, so nothing needs to be defined.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile; ... (minima=..., median=..., maxima=..., Q1=..., Q3=...)
error-bars-defined.explanation: Caption explicitly defines the box (Q1-Q3) and whisker endpoints (minima/maxima) for every group, so the box-plot elements are adequately defined.
GSEA enrichment plots show the running enrichment score curve without error bars.
Bar graph of log2 fold change per gene shows no error bars, only p-values labeled above bars.
Panel contains micrographs, not a plot.
